metadata.citation: Ilford, ILFORD HP5 PLUS Technical Information, November 2018, page 5 characteristic curve and page 1 wedge spectrogram; ILFOTEC HC 1+31, 6.5 min, 20 C.
metadata.datasource: https://ilford.co.jp/photo/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/TDS_HP5PLUS.pdf; PDF SHA256 b2006ecb9f96b1645726a90a7f15e798bdb7948b4ae1d0e6e9fa9719c93925f2; source SHA256 c4db3709ed09e9afaa4d3c21ffbbaa3778820ad907b2be4e638ef49b175dd1ba. ILFORD ILFOTEC HC (1+31) stock, 6.5 min at 20 C/68 F, intermittent agitation; 35mm/roll/sheet representative characteristic curve. Source-relative log-exposure reference 2.59831314431 on the p5 Relative log exposure axis; this is not an absolute lux-seconds origin. Rebuild scripts/prepare_hp5.py; see docs/hp5plus.md. Publication plots are embedded ~149-170 ppi raster images, not vector curves. The spectral ordinate is printed only as 'Sensitivity' with 0.5/1.0 ticks; the linear zero-based reading is an explicit interpretation, not a Harman statement. The p1 ordinate is a 2850 K tungsten wedge response; no equal-energy correction or source spectrum is supplied, so relative_sensitivity is not equal-energy film sensitivity. The 380-355 nm and 660-780 nm tails are endpoint-slope extrapolations clamped at 1e-12, not measured. No still-film RMS, MTF or resolving-power figure is published on the selected HP5 sheet. No layer decomposition, base spectrum, halation PSF or scanner response is supplied; densitometer=diffuse_visual and antihalation=weak are conservative metadata assumptions, not measurements. Scope is 135 still film; the p5 curve is representative of roll/sheet according to Harman and is not a format-specific measurement. One aggregate silver record is used; it is not a measured emulsion sublayer decomposition. Exposure zero is the first plotted density plus 1.0; that density is not a measured D-min. The characteristic curve clamps outside the plotted range; no inferred shoulder or extra latitude. Real scans are qualitative only and cannot establish scanner-independent physical fidelity.
